conf.description: Ivanti ICS user-access WELF (syslog-kv): splits the mostly-empty key=value envelope from msg and drives event.code/outcome/session off the message id, per recommendations.direct.cribl (envelope keys are blank on ~2,160 of ~3,150 ids and on the entire NWC class).

conf.comment: Ivanti ICS user-access WELF. ivs= is unquoted and can contain spaces ("ivs=Default Network"), which breaks naive kv splitting, so the whole envelope is pulled with one anchored regex instead of a generic kv parser. event.code/outcome are derived from msg per the message-id table (only the 4 documented AUT ids), not a full ~3,150-id lookup.

functions.description: why this pipeline exists and how it handles the ivs hazard

conf.regex: /^id=\S+ time="(?<time>[^"]*)" pri=(?<pri>\d*) fw=(?<fw>\S*) vpn=(?<vpn>\S*) ivs=(?<ivs>.*?) user=(?<user>\S*) realm="(?<realm>[^"]*)" roles="(?<roles>[^"]*)" proto=(?<proto>\S*) src=(?<src>\S*) dst=(?<dst>\S*) dstname=\S* type=\S* op=\S* arg="(?<arg>[^"]*)" result=(?<result>\S*) sent=(?<sent>\S*) rcvd=(?<rcvd>\S*) agent="(?<agent>[^"]*)" duration=\S* msg="(?<msg>.*)"$/

functions.description: split the WELF envelope; ivs captured non-greedily up to the following ' user=' so an embedded space in ivs cannot swallow the user= key
pull the 8-char session id out of msg's trailing (session:xxxxxxxx) - the only WELF-era join key between auth/tunnel/logout records
batch every clean 1:1 mapped field in one rename

event.code/outcome from the message-id table (result= is blank on virtually every auth record); roles to array; ivs/realm/proto to ivanti.ics.* customs; session id to ivanti.ics.session.id; byte/severity casts; _time (WELF time has no tz, treated as UTC pending appliance-tz confirmation - see README); event.dataset; drop the now-redundant raw envelope fields
